messages:
maya: FYI CI on main turned red after the constraints merge (https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/commit/ab12cd3). Integration jobs failing with DB errors when trying to run migrations.

ci-bot: [build #4821] FAILED - tests/integration/test_migrations.py::test_apply_migrations - FATAL: pg_config executable not found in PATH

alex: Is this the constraints bump that changed psycopg2-binary? I remember a note about relaxing the pin earlier.

maya: Yep, the merge relaxed our constraints file and allowed psycopg2-binary 2.9.7 -> installer reports needing libpq header. Local quick run shows the same: apt-based images pass but our musl-based runner (alpine) fails with "pg_config not found".

luisa: That would explain it. The wheel for 2.9.7 is not available for musl, so pip falls back to source build which requires libpq-dev.

alex: Can someone run a lockfile bisect? We need the exact commit that updated the constraint so we can either pin back or add libpq-dev to the image. I can run it if nobody else has time.

maya: Would appreciate that. Command we use: ``./scripts/lockfile-bisect --start upstream/constraints@sha1 --end HEAD --test "tox -e integration"``. It hacks through commits and runs a quick install+test.

sam: I started the bisect on a small runner just now. Leaving it running, will post the culprit commit.

infra-bot: New job queued: lock-bisect-1718509999 (runner: linux-musl). Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/job/lock-bisect-1718509999

sam: Bisect result: culprit commit ab12cd3 (the constraints PR #432). It relaxed "psycopg2-binary" upper bound and allowed 2.9.7.

luisa: Thanks. Options: 1) pin psycopg2-binary to <=2.9.6 in constraints, 2) add libpq-dev to our alpine CI images, or 3) use our Debian-based runners for integration tests only.

alex: Short-term I'd prefer pinning in constraints (fast revert). Long-term we'll probably add libpq-dev to the alpine image to support builds from source.

maya: Can someone open a small PR to pin and trigger CI? If we pin we should also add a note in the constraints PR review checklist to check musl wheels.

sam: I'll open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/435 - pins psycopg2-binary==2.9.6 in constraints and adds a comment.

alex: Nice, can you also add a one-liner in the CI image issues doc so we don't forget: "check musl wheel availability"?

sam: Done. Added a doc note and triggered a retest.

ci-bot: [build #4825] PASSED - integration matrix (after constraints pin)

maya: Awesome, thanks everyone. Follow-up: we'll add libpq-dev to alpine in a separate change and add a step to the constraints PR checklist.

luisa: :thumbsup:

alex: Glad that was quick. If this pops up again let's consider a small smoke job that installs from source on musl images as part of PR gating.

maya: Agreed. I'll add that to the eng-infra backlog.
